items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: Oscar Pettiford? Part Cherokee from out of Oklahoma.

ctx.x: Yeah, well, I mean, you know, you hear quite a lot of jazz musicians whose, you know, mother or father -- wasn't Oscar Pettiford --
Oscar Pettiford? Part Cherokee from out of Oklahoma. [side note: tribe]
Well, it just seems it is possible, you know, when you stop to sort of think of music being influenced by race (unintelligible) or whatever, that the Indian thing is in there too.
